dispositions.title: Model/view race
facts: driver.go Button.OnClick calls Activate under Application.Do.
MeshCanvas.Render calls Prepare under the same captured application owner.
Smoke model queries/column/source reads also use owner(a,...). Mutex ownership serializes goroutines; equal thread identity is unnecessary.

dispositions.title: Status callback race
facts: Driver refresh executes Window.View inside Application.Do; selectMode writes execute through owner-held Button.Activate.

dispositions.title: Nil/closed error channel
facts: main creates the private channel and never closes it.
Its only sender is OnError. Every adapter report call is guarded by a nonnil error; callback replacement errors use nonnil fmt.Errorf.
No external caller supplies or invokes the channel/callback.

dispositions.title: Worker resize
facts: SetSize called Screen before dispatch, invoking GLFW GetMonitor/GetPos/GetSize on the worker. Pinned GLFW headers require native main for those queries.
Application.Do alone would not marshal native queries.
The fixture now calls SetWinSize with native window coordinate sizes; atomic closure/flag checks precede RunOnMain, which checks Glw and performs SetSize on native main.
Independent drawing race/vet/build and live race fixture pass after the correction. Prism reviews only the changed hunk: zero findings.

corrective_review.scope: Unstaged three-line resize correction only; unchanged batch not repeated.

runs.scope: Affected public consumer; model tests reused their passing cache because model/test inputs did not change.

final_internal_result: Three findings refuted, one fixed; no further substantive defect in final correction. Read-only internal review; no repeated unchanged Prism.
